name: get_template_download
description: Get a single-use download grant for an activated (or free) template family: returns a URL, an Authorization header value (a secret: never log, print or commit it) that expires in 5 minutes, the version, the archive's sha256 and its size. Fetch with e.g. curl -fL -H "Authorization: <authorization_header>" -o <family>-<version>.zip <url>, then check the sha256 before unzipping. One grant starts one download; for a retry ask for a new grant. Each started download reserves the archive's full size against the account's download allowance (Free 500 MiB/month, Creator 10 GiB/billing month; 1 or 2 downloads at a time). Omit version for the latest. Does not use content operations.
